title: Normalized plan-audit intermediate representation
description: Internal audit input only. This is NOT the organizer case output contract and does not describe result.json. Numeric measurements, quantities, prices, domains, budgets, and ranked metrics use base-10 numeric strings for exact Fraction arithmetic; JSON numeric strings are preferred over binary floating-point numbers. Categorical parameter values and domains are literal strings. Missing evidence or unavailable values remain pending/unknown rather than becoming zero. Source checks establish locator and integrity facts only, never semantic scientific support.

example_notice.description: Required by convention on bundled examples to mark them synthetic, not an actual experiment, fixed test, price, or result.

defaults.description: Optional compact shared candidate fields. The five named arrays merge by stable entry key; every other candidate-owned field replaces the same default field. The auditor expands this mechanically before its existing checks.

numericString.description: Finite base-10 decimal or scientific notation; NaN, Infinity, fractions such as 1/3, and booleans are not accepted.

file.description: Actual local path, relative to --source-root when relative; never fetched from a network.

path.description: Optional actual path override when file is a display name.

file.description: A source_registry key, /input/case.json, or a legitimate local path. No URLs are fetched.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into a resolved JSON artifact.

raw.description: Expected original JSON literal at pointer, retaining its original JSON type. It is never a normalized numeric field: source JSON integer 6 must remain raw:6, while normalized quantities/parameters use numeric strings such as "6". Comparison is type-sensitive; numeric strings are not silently coerced to numbers.

quote.description: Short source excerpt for review; its presence is not proof of support.

locator.description: PDF figure/table/section or other human-review locator.

unit.description: Optional declared source unit, compared literally with normalization/output units.

oneOf.description: Explicit finite allowed values. Each entry is independently numeric or categorical; mixed domains retain per-entry types, numeric entries compare as exact rationals, and categorical entries compare as literal strings.
Closed interval intersected with origin + k*step for integer k; step must be strictly positive.

factor.description: Exact multiplier: normalized value = source.raw * factor.

unit.description: Result unit; must equal parameter.unit literally.

quantity.description: Total required by this candidate, including its already-designed controls, QC, and replicates; the auditor never infers runs.

stock_role.description: Source-driven stock semantics, never guessed from labels. capacity means stock_available is a permitted-use limit and never offsets consumption billing; quantity<=capacity is checked independently and unknown capacity leaves availability pending even when gross price is complete. purchase means explicit pre-owned stock offsets procurement need: shortfall=max(0,quantity-stock), packs=ceil(shortfall/pack_size), billed=packs*pack_size, and item_cost=billed*unit_price_minor. none is only for a case that explicitly defines gross consumption pricing with no stock rule for this item; it charges full quantity without declaring resource availability. none with stock_available is an error. Omitting stock_role preserves the legacy stock-dependent shortfall algorithm and pending unknown stock.

stock_available.description: Normalized decimal string interpreted only according to stock_role. The corresponding original JSON literal and type stay separately in source.raw.

pack_size.description: Positive exact package/procurement increment. Capacity rounds quantity, purchase rounds shortfall, and legacy behavior is unchanged when stock_role is omitted.

unit_price_minor.description: Normalized source price at the declared billing unit rate. Cost is always billed_quantity multiplied by this price. Pack procurement computes billed from exact pack rounding of shortfall; shortfall itself is never used as a lower-priced alternative. Source price-unit ambiguity remains marked by pending/source review rather than exploited to choose a cheaper plan.

fixed_cost_minor.description: Separate fixed charge, added once to the same-currency candidate total.

task.description: Schedule-owned fields remain intact and are passed to schedule.audit_schedule. Missing source or schedule evidence cannot become a skipped pass.

scientificCheck.description: Agent/expert scientific review declarations, not generic machine tests or safety approval. A declared pass without a claim or usable source locator is downgraded to pending.

items.description: Calendar fields remain scheduler-owned. An optional source receives the same locator/raw/integrity audit as other sources; it does not prove real availability.

budget_currency.description: Optional disambiguator. With multiple cost currencies, a budget without this field remains pending.

horizon_minutes.description: Latest permitted task-end offset from the common planning-origin minute zero. Checked exactly as every numeric task end <= horizon; absolute ISO timestamps use explicit deadlines instead.

time_origin.description: Optional scheduler-owned ISO time origin. The schedule parser still requires an explicit timezone and never invents a conversion.

declared_total_minor.description: Optional candidate total including fixed charges. A scalar is comparable only with one cost currency or explicit budget_currency.

declared_totals_minor.description: Currency-keyed candidate totals including fixed charges; comparable only when all item costs in that currency are known.

calendarPatch.description: A keyed calendar default or patch. Other scheduler-owned fields remain intact; capacity and available_intervals changes require a candidate-owned source during defaults expansion.

partialCandidate.description: Candidate defaults or a compact candidate patch. Stable entry keys are required; the expanded candidate is still checked by the auditor for all required fields.

compactCandidate.description: Used only when top-level defaults is present. Explicit null fields, including parent_id:null, are retained and override inherited values.
